Nepal says it cannot locate the original 1816 Sugauli Treaty that established its boundary with British India. Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said it remains unclear whether Nepal has an official copy of the treaty signed with Britain.

Journalist Anil Giri writing in The Kathmandu Post, quoted Khanal as saying in parliament that “The Government of Nepal does not have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents. There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we do not have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties.”

Nepal, however, has documents related to the 1816 treaty and the 1950 treaties, he said. The treaty provided the basis for the demarcation of the boundary between Nepal and then British India.

The original copy of the treaty has been missing since 2016 when the Eminent Persons Group began discussions on revising the 1950 Treaty of Peace & Friendship between India and Nepal. Kathmandu, it seems, has been using a copy of the original.

It triggered a parliamentary inquiry which found that even the original of the Treaty of Peace & Friendship was missing. In 2019, then foreign minister Pradeep Gyawali was quoted as saying that “We have both treaties, but we have to forensically verify whether these copies are originals or not. We are also trying to find historical documents and maps in India and the United Kingdom.”

The Treaty of Sugauli signed by Nepal and the East India Company required the former to cede large amounts of territory following its defeat in the Anglo-Nepal War. The Treaty of Friendship signed by the then Rana government of Nepal and India granted Indian and Nepalis reciprocal rights in either country.

While derided as “unequal” by various sections in Nepal, the treaty helped shape the relationship between Nepal and India.

नेपाल के कहनाय छनि जे ओ मूल 1816 के सुगौली संधि के पता नहि लगा सकैत अछि जे ब्रिटिश भारत सं अपन सीमा स्थापित केने छल. विदेश मंत्री शिसिर खनाल कहलनि जे, ब्रिटेन के संग हस्ताक्षरित संधि के आधिकारिक प्रति नेपाल लग अछि कि नहि से एखन धरि स्पष्ट नहि अछि।

पत्रकार अनिल गिरी द काठमांडू पोस्ट मे लिखैत, संसद मे खनालक उद्धृत करैत कहलनि जे, “नेपाल सरकार लग एहि बातक स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे हमरा सब लग आधिकारिक संधि दस्तावेज अछि कि नहि। एहन अभिलेख अछि जे किछु खास संधि स संबंधित किछु दस्तावेज राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार मे राखल जाइत अछि।मुदा हमरा सब लग स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे ओ वास्तविक आधिकारिक संधि अछि या नहि।”

ओना नेपाल मे १८१६ के संधि आ १९५० के संधि स संबंधित दस्तावेज अछि ओ कहलनि । ई संधि नेपाल आ तत्कालीन ब्रिटिश भारत के बीच सीमा के सीमांकन के आधार प्रदान केलक ।

संधि केरऽ मूल प्रति २०१६ स॑ गायब छै जब॑ ईमिनेंट पर्सन ग्रुप न॑ १९५० केरऽ भारत आरू नेपाल के बीच शांति आरू मैत्री संधि म॑ संशोधन करै के चर्चा शुरू करलकै । काठमांडू, बुझाइत अछि, मूलक प्रतिलिपि प्रयोग करैत आबि रहल अछि ।

एकरा स॑ संसदीय जांच शुरू होय गेलै जेकरा म॑ पता चललै कि शांति आरू दोस्ती केरऽ संधि केरऽ मूल भी गायब छै । 2019 में तत्कालीन विदेश मंत्री प्रदीप ज्ञानवाली के हवाला स कहल गेल छल जे “हमरा सब लग दुनू संधि अछि, मुदा हमरा सब के फोरेंसिक तरीका स सत्यापन करय पड़त जे ई प्रति सब मूल अछि या नै। हम सब भारत आ यूनाइटेड किंगडम में ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज आ नक्शा सेहो खोजय के कोशिश में छी।”

नेपाल आ ईस्ट इंडिया कम्पनी द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित सुगौली संधि मे आँग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध मे पराजित भेलाक बाद पूर्व केँ पैघ मात्रा मे क्षेत्र सौंपबाक आवश्यकता छल । नेपाल आ भारतक तत्कालीन राणा सरकार द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित मैत्री संधि मे भारतीय आ नेपाली केँ दुनू देश मे पारस्परिक अधिकार प्रदान कयल गेल छल |

नेपाल के विभिन्न वर्ग द्वारा “असमान” के रूप में उपहास करला के साथ ही ई संधि नेपाल आरू भारत के बीच के संबंध के आकार दै में मदद करलकै ।

Footage of men climbing to the top of a mosque's minaret and attempting to hoist a saffron flag has been falsely shared in social media posts claiming it shows Hindus vandalising a mosque during religious violence in southern Nepal in late July 2026. The footage has circulated since February 2020, and in fact shows a mosque that was vandalised in Delhi's Ashok Nagar area during deadly sectarian clashes.

"After Muslim jihadist extremists pelted stones at a Hindu procession, Hindus became furious and vandalised a mosque before setting it on fire," says part of the Hindi-language caption of a Facebook video shared on August 1, 2026.

The video shows men ripping off the muezzin's loudspeaker on top of the mosque's minaret and placing a Hindu religious flag and an Indian flag.

Screenshot of the false post captured on August 5, 2026, with a red X added by AFP

The clip also circulated in similar Instagram and X posts as violence between Hindu and Muslim communities in several towns in southern Nepal left at least three people dead and dozens injured ( archived link).

The violence began late on July 26 in a village in the southern Sunsari district, which borders India, after an argument over loud music and the use of religious flags during a Hindu procession, according to officials.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who has kept a low profile since being elected in March, broke his silence to deliver his first address to the nation, calling on his countrymen to be "responsible citizens and remove the clouds of unrest".

The circulating video, however, is several years old and in fact occurred in India's capital New Delhi.

A reverse image search on Google using keyframes from the falsely shared video led to the same clip shared on X on February 25, 2020 ( archived link).

The video is captioned: "Update Ashok Nagar, Delhi 6.00pm: A mosque has been vandalized by Hindutva terror forces, as they brazenly revisit their demolition tactics."

Screenshot comparison of the falsely shared video (L) and the X clip from February 2020

Similar visuals were also shared in media reports about sectarian violence that erupted in Delhi in February 2020 (archived here and here).

These clashes began on February 24, 2020 amid worsening religious tensions following a citizenship law that critics said was part of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Hindu nationalist agenda ( archived link). Supporters and detractors of the citizenship law then descended into pitched battles between the mobs.

The riots, among the worst communal violence in the capital in decades, left at least 27 people dead and more than 200 injured.

title: Old video from India misrepresented as sectarian violence in Nepal - Yahoo
description: Old video from India misrepresented as sectarian violence in Nepal  Yahoo
publisher.title: Yahoo
full_article:
Footage of men climbing to the top of a mosque's minaret and attempting to hoist a saffron flag has been falsely shared in social media posts claiming it shows Hindus vandalising a mosque during religious violence in southern Nepal in late July 2026. The footage has circulated since February 2020, and in fact shows a mosque that was vandalised in Delhi's Ashok Nagar area during deadly sectarian clashes.

"After Muslim jihadist extremists pelted stones at a Hindu procession, Hindus became furious and vandalised a mosque before setting it on fire," says part of the Hindi-language caption of a Facebook video shared on August 1, 2026.

The video shows men ripping off the muezzin's loudspeaker on top of the mosque's minaret and placing a Hindu religious flag and an Indian flag.

Screenshot of the false post captured on August 5, 2026, with a red X added by AFP

The clip also circulated in similar Instagram and X posts as violence between Hindu and Muslim communities in several towns in southern Nepal left at least three people dead and dozens injured ( archived link).

The violence began late on July 26 in a village in the southern Sunsari district, which borders India, after an argument over loud music and the use of religious flags during a Hindu procession, according to officials.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who has kept a low profile since being elected in March, broke his silence to deliver his first address to the nation, calling on his countrymen to be "responsible citizens and remove the clouds of unrest".

The circulating video, however, is several years old and in fact occurred in India's capital New Delhi.

A reverse image search on Google using keyframes from the falsely shared video led to the same clip shared on X on February 25, 2020 ( archived link).

Similar visuals were also shared in media reports about sectarian violence that erupted in Delhi in February 2020 (archived here and here).

These clashes began on February 24, 2020 amid worsening religious tensions following a citizenship law that critics said was part of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Hindu nationalist agenda ( archived link). Supporters and detractors of the citizenship law then descended into pitched battles between the mobs.

The riots, among the worst communal violence in the capital in decades, left at least 27 people dead and more than 200 injured.

Kathmandu, Aug 11: The Nepal Mobility Expo-2026 has commenced today at local Bhrikuti Mandap.

Inaugurating the Expo, Nepal Police Inspector General Dhan Bahadur Karki said there should be cooperation between the transport and mobility sectors for economic development.

“I believe exhibitions like this can serve as a milestone in the development of Nepal's transportation and mobility sector. title: 9 Deaths From Japanese Encephalitis in Nepal - Ratopati
description: 9 Deaths From Japanese Encephalitis in Nepal  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. In a period of 55 days, 9 people have died from Japanese Encephalitis across Nepal.

The Department of Health Services has stated that 46 people across the country have been infected with Japanese Encephalitis.

Also Read 9 people died from Japanese Encephalitis

An edited excerpt of the conversation with Dr. Abhiyan Gautam, Chief of the Child Health and Vaccination Service Branch under the Family Welfare Division of the Department, in this regard-

In a period of two months, 9 people died from Japanese Encephalitis across the country. What is the death rate in Nepal?

In the months of Asar and Saun, infection of this disease has been confirmed in 46 people, of whom 9 have already died. Compared to previous years, the death rate from this disease has increased this year.

What kind of environment and medium are considered favorable for the spread of Japanese Encephalitis?

Areas with high temperatures and stagnant water in the Terai and inner Madhesh regions, where paddy cultivation is done, are favorable environments for this disease. The 'Culex' mosquito lays eggs in stagnant paddy fields or ponds as a medium of infection. The cycle of infection involves pigs, swine, and ducks as 'amplifying hosts', where the number of viruses increases rapidly and quantitatively. When a mosquito that has bitten an infected pig or duck bites a human, the disease is transmitted to humans.

How to differentiate the symptoms of seasonal fever or flu and Japanese Encephalitis?

Seasonal fever involves common cold, cough, and fever. However, the symptoms of Japanese Encephalitis are very severe and serious. High fever, unbearable headache, changes in consciousness level, and gradual unconsciousness are symptoms of Japanese Encephalitis. Affected individuals may fall into a coma and require ICU or ventilator support.

How is it treated?

There is no specific antiviral medicine for Japanese Encephalitis. 'Supportive treatment' (treatment according to symptoms) is given based on the patient's condition. The patient may be given oxygen or ventilator support. If reached to the hospital quickly, complications and death can be avoided, and if delayed, there is a high risk of death due to severe brain damage (its mortality rate is about 30 percent).

What is the role of vaccination in preventing this disease and who is eligible?

This vaccine is given to children as part of the regular vaccination program, to children who have completed 12 months. Children up to 5 years of age can get it if they have missed it. Since vaccination has reached children, this disease is seen very rarely in children under 15 years of age. Currently, there is no regular vaccination system for adults. However, the government has conducted vaccination campaigns in high-risk areas (like Nawalpur). 95 to 100 percent of vaccinated people appear to be safe from its severe effects and death.

What personal and community-level precautions should be taken to prevent infection?

When going out, wear long-sleeved clothes, use a mosquito net compulsorily when sleeping at night, install nets on windows and doors, or use mosquito repellent incense or creams. Mosquitoes that transmit Japanese Encephalitis especially bite from evening to night and early morning. Pig, swine, and duck pens should be kept away from the house. Nets should be installed around the pens or an environment that repels mosquitoes should be created.

Does eating meat from infected pigs or ducks also transmit Japanese Encephalitis?

No. This disease is not transmitted by eating meat. It is a disease transmitted only by the bite of an infected mosquito.

What is the preparedness of hospitals in Nepal for the treatment of Japanese Encephalitis patients?

Primary testing and treatment facilities are available in district-level hospitals. Arrangements have been made to transfer seriously ill patients who require ICU or ventilator support to provincial or federal hospitals immediately for treatment.

दू महीना के अवधि में देश भर में जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस सं 9 लोक के मौत भ गेल. नेपालमे मृत्यु दर कितने अछि ?

असर आ सौन के महीना में 46 गोटे में एहि बीमारी के संक्रमण के पुष्टि भ चुकल अछि, जाहि में 9 गोटे के मौत भ चुकल अछि। पिछला साल क तुलना मे एहि साल एहि बीमारी स मौत क दर बढ़ल अछि।

जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ के प्रसार के लेल कोन तरहक वातावरण आ माध्यम अनुकूल मानल जाइत अछि ?

तराई आरू भीतरी मधेश क्षेत्रऽ म॑ अधिक तापमान आरू ठमकल पानी वाला क्षेत्र, जहां धान के खेती होय छै, ई बीमारी लेली अनुकूल वातावरण छै । ‘क्यूलेक्स’ मच्छर संक्रमण के माध्यम के रूप में ठहरल धान के खेत या पोखरि में अंडा दैत अछि | संक्रमण कें चक्र मे सुअर, सुअर, आ बतख कें ‘प्रवर्धन मेजबान’ कें रूप मे शामिल कैल जायत छै, जत वायरस कें संख्या तेजी सं आ मात्रात्मक रूप सं बढ़यत छै. संक्रमित सुअर या बतहा कें काटि लेने वाला मच्छर जखन मनुष्य कें काटएयत छै तखन इ बीमारी मनुष्यक मे संक्रमित भ जायत छै.

मौसमी बुखार या फ्लू आ जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ के लक्षण में कोना अंतर कयल जाय ?

मौसमी बुखार मे आम सर्दी, खांसी, आ बुखार शामिल छै. मुदा, जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथक लक्षण बहुत गंभीर आ गंभीर होइत छैक । तेज बुखार, असहनीय माथ दर्द, चेतनाक स्तर मे परिवर्तन, आ धीरे-धीरे बेहोशी जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथक लक्षण थिक । प्रभावित व्यक्ति कोमा मे आबि सकएय छै आ आईसीयू या वेंटिलेटर कें सहायता कें आवश्यकता भ सकएय छै.

एकर इलाज कोना होइत छैक ?

जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस कें लेल कोनों विशिष्ट एंटीवायरल दवाई नहि छै. रोगी कें स्थिति कें आधार पर ‘सहायक उपचार’ (लक्षणक कें अनुसार उपचार) देल जायत छै. रोगी कें ऑक्सीजन या वेंटिलेटर कें सहायता देल जा सकएय छै. यदि जल्दी अस्पताल पहुंचल जाय त जटिलता आ मौत सं बचल जा सकएय छै, आ अगर देरी भ जायत छै त मस्तिष्क कें गंभीर क्षति कें कारण मौत कें खतरा बेसि होयत छै (एकर मृत्यु दर लगभग 30 प्रतिशत छै) ।

अइ बीमारी कें रोकथाम मे टीकाकरण कें की भूमिका छै आ के पात्र छै?

इ टीका नियमित टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम कें हिस्साक कें रूप मे बच्चाक कें देल जायत छै, ओय बच्चाक कें जे 12 महीना पूरा करएयत छै. 5 साल तइक कें बच्चाक कें इ मिल सकएय छै अगर ओ एकरा छूटल छै. चूँकि टीकाकरण बच्चाक कें पास पहुंच गेल छै, अइ कें लेल इ बीमारी 15 साल सं कम उम्र कें बच्चाक मे बहुत कम देखल जायत छै. फिलहाल वयस्कक कें लेल नियमित टीकाकरण प्रणाली नहि छै. मुदा सरकार उच्च जोखिम वाला इलाका (जैना नवलपुर) मे टीकाकरण अभियान चला देलक अछि। टीकाकृत 95 सं 100 प्रतिशत लोग एकर गंभीर प्रभाव आ मौत सं सुरक्षित देखायत छै.

संक्रमण सं बचाव कें लेल व्यक्तिगत आ समुदाय स्तर कें की सावधानी बरतबाक चाही?

बाहर निकलएय कें समय लंबा बाजू कें कपड़ा पहनूं, रात मे सुतएय कें समय अनिवार्य रूप सं मच्छरदानी कें उपयोग करूं, खिड़की आ दरवाजाक पर जाल लगाऊं, या मच्छर भगाएय वाला धूप या क्रीम कें उपयोग करूं. जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस कें संक्रमण करएय वाला मच्छर विशेष रूप सं सांझ सं राति आ भोरे-भोर कें काटएयत छै. सुग्गर, सुअर, आ बतहाक कें गोला घर सं दूर राखल जेबाक चाही. पेन कें चारू कात जाल लगाएल जेबाक चाही या मच्छर कें भगाएय वाला वातावरण बनावा जैबाक चाही.

की संक्रमित सुअर या बतहा कें मांस खाएय सं जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ कें संक्रमण सेहो होयत छै?

नहि ई रोग मांस खएला सँ नहि होइत अछि । इ एकटा एहन बीमारी छै जे केवल संक्रमित मच्छर कें काटला सं संक्रमित होयत छै.

जापानी इन्सेफेलाइटिस के मरीज के इलाज के लेल नेपाल के अस्पताल के की तैयारी अछि ?

जिला स्तरीय अस्पताल मे प्राथमिक जांच आ इलाज कें सुविधा उपलब्ध छै. गंभीर रूप सं बीमार मरीज कें इलाज कें लेल तुरंत प्रांतीय या संघीय अस्पताल मे स्थानांतरित करय कें व्यवस्था कैल गेल छै.

title: Nepal Police Prioritizes Tech-Based Investigation to Curb Online Misinformation and Fraud - Ratopati
description: Nepal Police Prioritizes Tech-Based Investigation to Curb Online Misinformation and Fraud  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. As incidents of fake news, misleading information, 'deepfakes', 'hate speech', and cyber fraud spreading through social media increase, Nepal Police has prioritized a technology-friendly investigation and monitoring system to control such activities.

Inspector General of Nepal Police, Dan Bahadur Karki, stated that the police are aware that the misuse of social media can disrupt goodwill among citizens and pose challenges to peace and security. According to him, the police are further strengthening their manpower and technology to control the negative activities arising from the use of social media.

He said that preparations are being made to equip the Cyber Bureau with more resources and deploy skilled manpower in technology for monitoring and investigating such activities. The police are also making the monitoring of social media activities effective through the 'Advanced Analytics Cell'.

"The police have prioritized identifying the source of such content and bringing it under the legal framework, as fake and misleading information, deepfakes, and hate speech spread on social media can affect social harmony," said Inspector General Karki. "For this, coordination has also been done with relevant service providers, government agencies, and other stakeholders."

According to him, along with the misuse of social media, online fraud has also become a major challenge for the police in recent times. He expressed confidence that the police will be able to control incidents of fraud such as tricking people by claiming they have won online lotteries, asking for personal and banking details in the name of KYC updates, withdrawing money by taking OTPs, and committing financial fraud through various temptations.

Inspector General Karki informed that the police have been carrying out public awareness campaigns along with investigations and actions to control such crimes. The police have been urging citizens not to believe messages claiming they have won a lottery when they have not participated, not to give OTPs to unknown individuals, and not to provide personal details based on calls claiming to be from banks or financial institutions.

According to Inspector General Karki, a concept to establish an 'Anti Cyber Scam Center' is also being advanced to control cyber fraud. He informed that the proposed mechanism will involve coordination between banks and financial institutions, Nepal Rastra Bank, police, and the telecommunication sector to enable immediate response as soon as a victim realizes they have been defrauded.

He expressed the belief that by receiving immediate information about cyber fraud incidents, criminal activities can be reduced. He stated that a system will be developed to receive information quickly through various means and mobilize the relevant agencies.

Similarly, the police are preparing to develop an 'Immediate Financial Fraud Reporting System' or e-reporting system. Through this system, citizens can immediately provide information to the police if they are defrauded. The goal is to minimize financial losses from fraud by coordinating between the concerned banks and financial institutions, telecommunication service providers, and the police as soon as information is received.

The police have also prioritized international cooperation in cybercrime investigation. Since most of the infrastructure of social media and digital service providers is located outside Nepal, Inspector General Karki said that investigations are being carried out in coordination with the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol), police forces of various countries, and relevant technology service providers.

In the process of expanding the use of technology to control the misuse of social media, preparations are being made to gradually connect surveillance cameras installed in public places with artificial intelligence (AI). He informed that there is a plan to use AI in crowded places for technologies such as facial recognition.

The police have emphasized controlling criminal activities, investigation, and legal action resulting from the misuse of social media. Inspector General Karki stated that as technology develops, the nature of crime also changes, and traditional policing methods alone cannot cope with new challenges.

The police have urged citizens to use social media responsibly, as false information and rumors spread through social media can create distrust and tension among citizens. According to the police, re-broadcasting information on social media without verifying its authenticity as soon as it is received is also a cause of the problem.

The police have pointed out the need to expand awareness about the responsible use of social media from the school level. The police have concluded that digital crime and misuse can only be controlled through the cooperation of citizens, media, social media users, service providers, and security agencies.

काठमांडू। सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स॑ फैललऽ फेक न्यूज, भ्रामक जानकारी, ‘डीपफेक’, ‘हेट स्पीच’, आरू साइबर धोखाधड़ी के घटना बढ़ला के साथ-साथ नेपाल पुलिस न॑ ऐसनऽ गतिविधि क॑ नियंत्रित करै लेली तकनीक के अनुकूल जांच आरू निगरानी प्रणाली क॑ प्राथमिकता देल॑ छै ।

नेपाल प्रहरी महानिरीक्षक दानबहादुर कार्की सोशल मिडियाके दुरुपयोगसँ नागरिकमे सद्भावना बाधित भऽ शान्ति आ सुरक्षाके लेल चुनौती बनि सकैत अछि से पुलिस अवगत रहल बतौलनि । हुनकऽ अनुसार पुलिस सोशल मीडिया के उपयोग स॑ पैदा होय वाला नकारात्मक गतिविधि प॑ नियंत्रण रखै लेली अपनऽ जनशक्ति आरू तकनीक क॑ आरू मजबूत करी रहलऽ छै ।

ओ कहला जे साइबर ब्यूरो कए बेसी संसाधन स लैस करबाक तैयारी कैल जा रहल अछि आ एहि तरहक गतिविधि क निगरानी आ जांच लेल तकनीक मे कुशल जनशक्ति तैनात कैल जा रहल अछि। पुलिस ‘एडवांस्ड एनालिटिक्स सेल’ के माध्यम सं सोशल मीडिया गतिविधि के निगरानी के सेहो प्रभावी बना रहल अछि.

महानिरीक्षक कार्की नँ कहलकै कि पुलिस नँ ऐसनौ सामग्री के स्रोत के पहचान करी क ओकरा कानूनी ढाँचा मँ लानै क प्राथमिकता देलकै, कैन्हेंकि सोशल मीडिया प फैललौ फर्जी आरू भ्रामक जानकारी, डीपफेक, आरू नफरत के भाषण सामाजिक सौहार्द क प्रभावित करी सकै छै । "एकरा लेली संबंधित सेवा प्रदाता, सरकारी एजेंसी, आरू अन्य हितधारकऽ के साथ भी समन्वय करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।"

हुनकऽ अनुसार सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग के साथ-साथ ऑनलाइन धोखाधड़ी भी हाल के समय म॑ पुलिस लेली एगो बड़ऽ चुनौती बनी गेलऽ छै । ओ विश्वास जतौलनि जे पुलिस ऑनलाइन लॉटरी जीतबाक दावा कए लोक कए छल करब, केवाईसी अपडेट क नाम पर व्यक्तिगत आ बैंकिंग विवरण मांगब, ओटीपी ल कए पैसा निकालब, आ विभिन्न प्रलोभन क माध्यम स वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी करब जेहन धोखाधड़ी क घटना कए नियंत्रित करबा मे सक्षम होएत।

महानिरीक्षक कार्की जानकारी देलनि जे पुलिस एहि तरहक अपराध पर नियंत्रण करबाक लेल जांच आ कार्रवाईक संग जन जागरूकता अभियान सेहो चला रहल अछि। पुलिस नागरिक सब स आग्रह करैत रहल अछि जे जखन ओ भाग नहि लेने छथि तखन लॉटरी जीतबाक दावा करय वाला संदेश पर विश्वास नहि करथि, अनजान व्यक्ति के ओटीपी नहि देथि, आ बैंक या वित्तीय संस्थान के फोन के आधार पर व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहि देथि।

महानिरीक्षक कार्की के अनुसार साइबर धोखाधड़ी पर नियंत्रण के लेल ‘एंटी साइबर घोटाला केंद्र’ के स्थापना के अवधारणा सेहो आगू बढ़ाओल जा रहल अछि। ओ जानकारी देलनि जे प्रस्तावित तंत्र मे बैंक आ वित्तीय संस्था, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक, पुलिस, आ दूरसंचार क्षेत्रक बीच समन्वय शामिल होयत जाहि सँ पीड़ित केँ ठकबाक अहसास होइते तत्काल प्रतिक्रिया संभव होयत।

हुनी ई विश्वास व्यक्त करलकै कि साइबर धोखाधड़ी के घटना के तुरंत जानकारी मिलला स॑ आपराधिक गतिविधि म॑ कमी ​​आबी सकै छै । ओ कहलनि जे, विभिन्न माध्यम सं सूचना जल्दी सं प्राप्त करय आ संबंधित एजेंसी के जुटाबय के व्यवस्था बनाओल जायत.

तहिना पुलिस ‘तत्काल वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी रिपोर्टिंग प्रणाली’ या ई रिपोर्टिंग प्रणाली विकसित करबाक तैयारी मे अछि। एहि प्रणाली के माध्यम सं नागरिक धोखाधड़ी भेला पर तुरंत पुलिस के जानकारी द सकय छथिन्ह. लक्ष्य छै कि जानकारी मिलतें ही संबंधित बैंक आरू वित्तीय संस्थान, दूरसंचार सेवा प्रदाता, आरू पुलिस के बीच समन्वय करी क॑ धोखाधड़ी स॑ होय वाला आर्थिक नुकसान क॑ कम स॑ कम करलऽ जाय ।

पुलिस साइबर अपराध के जांच मे अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहयोग के सेहो प्राथमिकता देलक अछि. सोशल मिडिया आ डिजिटल सेवा प्रदाता के अधिकांश बुनियादी ढांचा नेपाल स बाहर रहला स महानिरीक्षक कार्की कहला जे अंतरराष्ट्रीय आपराधिक पुलिस संगठन (इंटरपोल), विभिन्न देश क पुलिस बल, आ संबंधित प्रौद्योगिकी सेवा प्रदाता क संग समन्वय क जांच भ रहल अछि।

सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग पर नियंत्रण के लेल तकनीक के उपयोग के विस्तार के प्रक्रिया में सार्वजनिक स्थान पर लगाओल गेल निगरानी कैमरा के धीरे-धीरे आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (एआई) सं जोड़य के तैयारी भ रहल अछि. ओ जानकारी देलनि जे फेशियल रिकग्निशन जेहन तकनीक लेल भीड़भाड़ वाला जगह पर एआई के उपयोग करबाक योजना अछि।

पुलिस सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग के परिणामस्वरूप आपराधिक गतिविधि, जांच, आ कानूनी कार्रवाई पर नियंत्रण पर जोर देलक अछि. महानिरीक्षक कार्की नँ कहलकै कि जेना-जेना तकनीक के विकास होय छै, अपराध के प्रकृति भी बदलै छै, आरू पारंपरिक पुलिसिंग के तरीका ही नया चुनौती के सामना नै करी सकै छै ।

पुलिस नागरिक सब स सोशल मीडिया के जिम्मेदारी स उपयोग करबाक आग्रह केलक अछि, कियाक त सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स गलत जानकारी आ अफवाह फैलल नागरिक के बीच अविश्वास आ तनाव पैदा भ सकैत अछि। पुलिस के अनुसार सूचना मिलैत देरी बिना ओकर प्रामाणिकता के सत्यापन केने सोशल मीडिया पर फेर सं प्रसारित करब सेहो समस्या के कारण अछि.

पुलिस स्कूल स्तर सं सोशल मीडिया के जिम्मेदार उपयोग के बारे मे जागरूकता बढ़ाबय के जरूरत के ओर इशारा केलक अछि. पुलिस न॑ ई निष्कर्ष निकाललकै कि डिजिटल अपराध आरू दुरुपयोग प॑ नागरिक, मीडिया, सोशल मीडिया यूजर, सेवा प्रदाता, आरू सुरक्षा एजेंसी के सहयोग स॑ ही नियंत्रण करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

The International Labour Organization (ILO) welcomes and commends the Government of Nepal on its ratification of two landmark ILO instruments: the Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (Protocol No. 29) and the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (Convention No. 81), following their adoption by the Federal Parliament. The instruments of ratification were formally deposited during a ceremony held at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

© Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. © Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. Nepal deposited the instruments of ratification of the Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (Protocol No. 29) and the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (Convention No. 81) at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

The ILO also recognizes the leadership and collective efforts of the Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav, Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment (MoYLE), the concerned ministries, parliamentarians, workers' and employers' organizations, and all social partners in advancing these ratifications.

Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav said, "The ratification of these two ILO instruments reaffirms Nepal's commitment to promoting decent work, safeguarding workers' rights, and strengthening protections against forced labour. It will further strengthen our existing labour system and enhance our efforts to prevent exploitation, improve labour inspection, and ensure that labour rights are effectively protected and upheld."

© File photo © File photo Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav, Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment (MoYLE), presenting the proposal to Parliament for approval of the ratification of the Conventions.

By ratifying Convention No. 81, Nepal will strengthen its labour inspection system to better ensure safe, healthy and decent working conditions for all workers. Effective labour inspection is essential for enforcing labour laws, promoting compliance and protecting workers' rights across all sectors of the economy.

The Convention will improve the enforcement of laws on wages, working time, occupational safety and health, child labour and other fundamental labour protections, helping ensure that workers' rights are upheld not only in legislation but also in factories, shops, construction sites, service workplaces and other places of work.

The ratification of Protocol No. 29 will strengthen Nepal's efforts to prevent and eliminate forced labour, protect victims, ensure access to justice and remedies, including compensation and legal assistance, and address trafficking in persons for forced labour. It will support stronger measures to identify, release, protect and rehabilitate victims, including migrant workers and people in vulnerable situations.

© Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. © Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. H.E. Ambassador Ram Prasad Subedi, Permanent Representative of Nepal in Geneva, deposited the Instruments of Ratification with Gilbert F. Houngbo, ILO Director-General, during a ceremony held at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

"This is a proud and significant moment for Nepal," said Numan Özcan, ILO Country Director for Nepal. "By advancing these two instruments, the Government is sending a clear message that every worker matters. Their ratification will help turn the promise of decent work into a lived reality. I congratulate the Government of Nepal and all those who contributed to this important milestone through their leadership, commitment and collaboration."

As Nepal prepares for graduation from Least Developed Country (LDC) status and explores future trade opportunities, including possible access to the European Union's GSP+ framework, strong labour standards and their effective implementation will be increasingly important to protect workers and support sustainable economic growth.

Effective labour inspection benefits workers, responsible employers and the national economy alike. Fair and consistent enforcement helps create a level playing field for businesses, reduce labour disputes, prevent workplace accidents and abuse, promote productivity, and strengthen confidence in the rule of law. Likewise, eliminating forced labour contributes to poverty reduction, the formalization of employment and Nepal's vision of inclusive and sustainable prosperity founded on decent work.

By ratifying these two instruments, Nepal has taken an important step towards a future in which no one is subjected to forced labour, every worker enjoys effective protection under the law, and every workplace upholds dignity, safety and justice.

The ILO stands ready to continue working with the Government of Nepal, employers' and workers' organizations, civil society and development partners to support the effective implementation of these commitments.

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय श्रम संगठन (आईएलओ) संघीय संसद द्वारा अपनाओल गेलाक बाद आईएलओक दूटा महत्वपूर्ण यंत्र : जबरदस्ती श्रम सम्मेलन, १९३० (प्रोटोकॉल संख्या २९) केर २०१४ केर प्रोटोकॉल आ श्रम निरीक्षण महासन्धि, १९४७ (सम्मेलन संख्या ८१) केर अनुमोदन पर नेपाल सरकारक स्वागत आ प्रशंसा करैत अछि । अनुमोदन केरऽ दस्तावेज क॑ औपचारिक रूप स॑ ७ अगस्त २०२६ क॑ जिनेवा म॑ आईएलओ मुख्यालय म॑ आयोजित एगो समारोह के दौरान जमा करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

आईएलओ माननीय राष्ट्रपति केरऽ नेतृत्व आरू सामूहिक प्रयास क॑ भी पहचानै छै । मंत्री रामजी यादव, युवा, श्रम आ रोजगार मंत्रालय (मोवाईएलई), संबंधित मंत्रालय, संसद सदस्य, मजदूर आ नियोक्ता संगठन, आ सब सामाजिक भागीदार एहि अनुमोदन कए आगू बढ़ेबा मे।

माननीय डॉ. मंत्री रामजी यादव कहलनि जे, "आईएलओ के ई दुनू यंत्र के अनुमोदन नेपाल के सभ्य काज के बढ़ावा देबय, मजदूर के अधिकार के रक्षा करय, आ जबरन श्रम के खिलाफ सुरक्षा के मजबूत करय के प्रतिबद्धता के दोबारा पुष्टि करैत अछि. एहि सं हमर मौजूदा श्रम प्रणाली के आओर मजबूती मिलत आओर शोषण रोकय, श्रम निरीक्षण मे सुधार, आओर श्रम अधिकार के प्रभावी ढंग सं सुरक्षा आओर कायम राखय के हमर प्रयास मे वृद्धि होएत."

सम्मेलन नम्बर ८१ के अनुमोदन क नेपाल अपन श्रम निरीक्षण प्रणाली के मजबूत करत जाहि स सब मजदूर के सुरक्षित, स्वस्थ आ सभ्य काज के स्थिति बेहतर ढंग स सुनिश्चित होयत। श्रम कानून कें लागू करय, अनुपालन कें बढ़ावा देवय आ अर्थव्यवस्था कें सब क्षेत्रक मे श्रमिकक कें अधिकारक कें सुरक्षा कें लेल प्रभावी श्रम निरीक्षण आवश्यक छै.

इ महासन्धि मजदूरी, काम कें समय, व्यावसायिक सुरक्षा आ स्वास्थ्य, बाल श्रम आ अन्य मौलिक श्रम संरक्षणक कें कानून कें प्रवर्तन मे सुधार करतय, जे इ सुनिश्चित करय मे मदद करतय कि श्रमिकक कें अधिकारक कें न केवल कानून मे बल्कि फैक्ट्री, दुकान, निर्माण स्थल, सेवा कार्यस्थल आ अन्य कार्यस्थल मे सेहो कायम राखल जाय.

प्रोटोकॉल नम्बर २९ के अनुमोदन स जबरन श्रम के रोकथाम आ समाप्त करब, पीड़ित के सुरक्षा, मुआवजा आ कानूनी सहायता सहित न्याय आ उपाय तक पहुंच सुनिश्चित करब आ जबरदस्ती श्रम के लेल व्यक्ति के तस्करी के संबोधित करय के लेल नेपाल के प्रयास मजबूत होयत। इ प्रवासी श्रमिकक आ कमजोर परिस्थितिक मे लोगक सहित पीड़ितक कें पहचान, रिहाई, सुरक्षा आ पुनर्वास कें लेल मजबूत उपायक कें समर्थन करतय.

जेना-जेना नेपाल अल्पविकसित देश (एलडीसी) के दर्जा स स्नातक के तैयारी करत आ यूरोपीय संघ के जीएसपी+ ढाँचा तक संभावित पहुंच सहित भविष्य के व्यापारिक अवसर के खोज करत, मजबूत श्रम मानक आ ओकर प्रभावी क्रियान्वयन मजदूर के सुरक्षा आ टिकाऊ आर्थिक विकास के समर्थन के लेल तेजी स महत्वपूर्ण होयत।

प्रभावी श्रम निरीक्षण सं मजदूर, जिम्मेदार नियोक्ता आ राष्ट्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था कें समान लाभ होयत छै. निष्पक्ष आ लगातार प्रवर्तन व्यवसायक कें लेल एकटा समान खेल कें मैदान बनावा मे मदद करएयत छै, श्रम विवादक कें कम करएयत छै, कार्यस्थल पर दुर्घटना आ दुरुपयोग कें रोकएयत छै, उत्पादकता कें बढ़ावा देयत छै, आ कानून कें राज मे विश्वास कें मजबूत करएयत छै. तहिना जबरदस्ती श्रम समाप्त करब गरीबी कम करब, रोजगारक औपचारिकता आ सभ्य काज पर आधारित समावेशी आ टिकाऊ समृद्धिक नेपालक दृष्टि मे योगदान दैत अछि ।

ई दूनू यंत्र के अनुमोदन क नेपाल एकटा एहन भविष्य के दिशा में एकटा महत्वपूर्ण डेग उठेलक अछि जाहि में ककरो जबरदस्ती श्रम के शिकार नै हो, हर मजदूर के कानून के तहत प्रभावी सुरक्षा भेटय, आ हर कार्यस्थल गरिमा, सुरक्षा आ न्याय के कायम राखल जाय।

full_article:
KATHMANDU: Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) has made major changes to the national cricket squad after the team’s disappointing performance during its Netherlands tour under the ICC World Cup League-2.

Ahead of the upcoming ACC Premier Cup, CAN has dropped several senior and experienced players and opted to give opportunities to younger players.

According to CAN’s latest decision, senior pacer Sompal Kami, all-rounder Aarif Sheikh, Bhim Sharki, Binod Bhandari and Nandan Yadav have been left out of both the senior and Nepal ‘A’ squads.

Regular opener Kushal Bhurtel, meanwhile, has been demoted from the senior squad to the Nepal ‘A’ team.

Following the team’s below-par performance in the Netherlands, CAN has prioritised young players in both the batting and bowling departments.

Young batters Dev Khanal and Sundeep Jora, along with left-arm spin all-rounder Basir Ahmed, have secured places in the senior squad.

Mystery spinner Sher Malla, who has impressed in domestic cricket, has also been included in the ODI national squad for the first time.

The latest squad reshuffle comes after Nepal’s continued underwhelming performances and is being viewed as a strong signal of CAN’s intention to introduce fresh thinking, increase competition within the team and prepare for the future.

Kushal Bhurtel, Sompal Kami, Bhim Sharki, Nandan Yadav, Aarif Sheikh and Binod Bhandari have been dropped from the senior team.

Meanwhile, young players Dev Khanal, Sher Malla, Sundeep Jora and Basir Ahmed have been brought into the senior squad.
